items.title: Empirical priors fitted separately for missense and nonsense
assumptions: All included gnomAD carriers are treated as unaffected.

source.label: Frozen observed-variant count analysis

metricDefinitions.label: Empirical prior mean
metricDefinitions.definition: The prior mean is fitted separately within each gene and variant type using the existing historical count-weighted moment method.

metricDefinitions.label: Unaffected singleton posterior
metricDefinitions.definition: One unaffected carrier updates Beta(alpha, beta) to Beta(alpha, beta + 1).

filters: Genes: HNF1A, GCK, LDLR, BRCA2, KCNQ1
Types: canonical missense and nonsense, fitted separately
Canonical reference amino acid: validated match
Population variants: frozen gnomAD 4.1.1 QC-passing observations
caveats: Synonymous, frameshift, splice and noncoding variants do not enter either prior.
The historical n=1 fitting weight is 0.009901; singleton counts still update their own posterior in full.
These are empirical estimates from the observed count collection, not independently calibrated outcome risks.

evidenceFlow.title: Class isolation
evidenceFlow.detail: Six tests passed, including invariance to adding other variant classes, nonsense-to-missense isolation, stop-label equivalence and unaffected-singleton beta-only updates.

methods.code:
def fit_empirical(units, variance_mode="historical"):
    y = units.affected.to_numpy() / units.n.to_numpy()
    weights = 1 - 1 / (units.n.to_numpy() + 0.01)
    mean = float(np.average(y, weights=weights))
    mse = float(np.mean(weights * (y - mean) ** 2))
    normalized_mse = float(np.average((y - mean) ** 2, weights=weights))
    variance = mse if variance_mode == "historical" else normalized_mse
    if not 0 < mean < 1 or not 0 < variance < mean * (1 - mean):
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid empirical Beta moments: {mean=}, {variance=}")
    strength = mean * (1 - mean) / variance - 1
    alpha, beta = mean * strength, (1 - mean) * strength
    return {
        "mean": mean,
        "variance": variance,
        "historical_mse": mse,
        "normalized_weighted_mse": normalized_mse,
        "weighted_mae": float(np.average(abs(y - mean), weights=weights)),
        "alpha_empirical": alpha,
        "beta_empirical": beta,
        "strength": strength,
        "pooled_carrier_fraction": float(units.affected.sum() / units.n.sum()),
        "equal_variant_fraction_mean": float(y.mean()),
    }

kappa = alpha + beta
prior_mean = alpha / kappa
A=0, U=1: posterior_mean = alpha / (kappa + 1)
GCK missense: 1.081159 / (2.918755 + 1) = 0.275894
GCK nonsense: 3.636752 / (5.151915 + 1) = 0.591158
